title: Typing and fixing mistakes
summary: Undo, copy and paste, selecting words, and saving.

steps.title: Open about.txt
steps.say: Let's practice on the file you made. (Make it first with the **Make a folder and a file** guide if it's not there.) Press **Ctrl+P**, type `about` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders. Click somewhere in the editor first, so it hears your keys.

steps.title: The cursor
steps.say: The blinking line in the text is the **cursor**. It's where your typing goes. Click anywhere in your words to move it, and press the **arrow keys** to walk it around.

waitFor.hint: click in your text and press the arrow keys.

steps.title: Erase
steps.say: Press **Backspace** to erase the letter before the cursor, and **Delete** to erase the one after it. Type a few extra letters and erase them again.

waitFor.hint: type some letters, then erase them.

steps.title: Undo!
steps.say: Made a mistake? Press **Ctrl+Z** to **undo**: it takes back your last change. Press it again to go back further. **Ctrl+Y** puts a change back (redo). Nothing you type is permanent until you want it to be.

steps.title: Select
steps.say: **Double-click** a word to select it (it turns highlighted). **Triple-click** selects the whole line, and **Ctrl+A** selects everything.

waitFor.hint: double-click a word, then try triple-click.

steps.title: Copy and paste
steps.say: With some words selected, press **Ctrl+C** to **copy** them, click somewhere else, and press **Ctrl+V** to **paste** a copy. **Ctrl+X** is **cut**: copy, and remove the original.

waitFor.hint: select a word, copy it, and paste it.

steps.title: Save
steps.say: Press **Ctrl+S** to save. Do it after every change you want to keep, even if the editor sometimes saves by itself. Programs only see what's been saved.

steps.title: Nice work
steps.say: Undo, copy, paste and save are the four moves you'll use all day. Next, try **Rename and delete**.
